messages:
marta: Customer (Acme Corp) reporting payment failure for invoice INV-2026-102. Billing webhook shows charge.failed, decline_code=do_not_honor. They tried corporate card and got a bank message. Any ideas?

billing-bot: Payment failed: stripe.charges.failed id=ch_1JZxxxx amount=12300 currency=usd reason=card_declined retry=false

tom: Can you paste last4 + BIN? Also ask whether the card has MCC/spend controls. Issuers often block high-ticket SaaS charges.

marta: last4=4242, bin=400000, cardholder="Acme Purchasing", card type=corporate. Customer says bank message said: 'merchant not allowed'.

julie: :thinking: "merchant not allowed" usually indicates issuer blocked our MCC. On Stripe that shows decline_code=merchant_not_allowed in the auth response.

payments-ops: If it's merchant_not_allowed, issuer blocked that MCC. Recommend customer ask bank to whitelist our MCC (see below) or check corporate spend caps (per-txn limit).

marta: We need exact MCC and merchant descriptor to give the customer. I can't find MCC in the UI snapshot here.

tom: You can query Stripe API for the charge object. Example:

curl -s -u sk_live: https://api.stripe.com/v1/charges/ch_1JZxxxx | jq '.payment_method_details.card.mcc, .billing_details.name'

billing-bot: Charge ch_1JZxxxx: payment_method_details.card.mcc = "5734"; merchant_display_name = "Redwood Inference"

julie: Good — MCC 5734 (Computer Software). Share that + descriptor "Redwood Inference" with the customer and ask their issuer to allow MCC 5734. Also check if their card has a single-transaction cap (< $10k) — invoice is $12,300.

marta: Customer replied: their AP policy enforces single-transaction cap of $10k for procurement cards. So this looks like a spend limit, not MCC block. They saw both messages because issuer UI is generic.

payments-ops: Options to propose: 1) split the invoice into two payments (we create two invoices/charges). 2) Accept PO + wire. 3) Customer asks issuer to temporarily raise per-transaction limit. 4) use alternative card.

sam: I can draft a short template the customer can send to their bank: "Please allow transactions to merchant MCC 5734 (Computer Software) and temporarily raise single-transaction limit to $15,000 for card ending 4242."

marta: Please cc billing@redwood.com and include invoice link https://console.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-102 when sending. I'll update the support ticket.

tom: :thumbsup: I'll disable automatic retries on the invoice so we don't spam attempts while they sort limits. Adding a note to the invoice record.

marta: Customer chose PO/wire to clear this invoice. Marking thread resolved, will follow up when funds settled. :white_check_mark:
